proof_body:
by
  intro R _ Y S hS n
  refine ⟨fun x => ⟨fun h => CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₂ hS Y x h, ?_⟩, fun x => ⟨fun h => CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₁ hS Y x (add_comm 1 n) h, ?_⟩, fun x => ⟨fun h => CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₃ hS Y x h (add_comm 1 n), ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨x₃, rfl⟩
    rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc, S.zero, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_zero, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.zero_comp]
  · rintro ⟨x₂, rfl⟩
    exact hS.extClass_comp_assoc x₂
  · rintro ⟨x₁, rfl⟩
    exact hS.comp_extClass_assoc x₁ _
target_source: ∀ (R : Type) [Ring R] (Y : ModuleCat.{0} R) (S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{0} R)) (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℕ), (∀ x₂ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext S.X₂ Y n, (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.f).comp x₂ (zero_add n) = 0 ↔ ∃ x₃ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext S.X₃ Y n, (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g).comp x₃ (zero_add n) = x₂) ∧ (∀ x₁ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext S.X₁ Y n, hS.extClass.comp x₁ (add_comm 1 n) = 0 ↔ ∃ x₂ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext S.X₂ Y n, (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.f).comp x₂ (zero_add n) = x₁) ∧ (∀ x₃ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext S.X₃ Y (n + 1), (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g).comp x₃ (zero_add (n + 1)) = 0 ↔ ∃ x₁ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext S.X₁ Y n, hS.extClass.comp x₁ (add_comm 1 n) = x₃)
